title: Lease
description: A time-bounded, heartbeat-renewed hold on a single claimed resource instance, used to detect and reclaim abandoned resource claims.

resource_type.description: Abstract resource category, e.g. 'compute-slot' or 'memory' — illustrative only, not a fixed enum. Must never name a specific vendor or hardware model.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier for the specific claimed instance of the resource this lease holds.

owner.description: Opaque identifier of the graph node or executor holding the lease.

epoch.description: Monotonically increasing generation counter, incremented each time the lease is reacquired after expiry.

heartbeat_deadline.description: Unix epoch seconds by which the next heartbeat must arrive or the lease is considered expired.
